title: Survival Plain - Rosebud AI Game made by Sarottle.
author: TheAlqyngh
selftext:
So This is Survival Plain with 83 Plays, I need some feedback, [https://rosebud.ai/play/survival-plain-1](https://rosebud.ai/play/survival-plain-1)

and Subscribe (Discouraged) if you want, maybe I'll make a lame gameplay:

[https://www.youtube.com/@Moon\_Crescent2341OOO](https://www.youtube.com/@Moon_Crescent2341OOO)

comments.author: loontoon
comments.body:
One small suggestion. 

Seeing as many people are reading Reddit on their phones, if your game doesn't work on mobile, tell people upfront so they don't click and then get frustrated.

replies.author: TheAlqyngh
replies.body: In the editor I asked the AI to make it mobile 4-6 times. It failed.

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
Claude made mine mobile capable with no problem, but my game now has so many buttons that it won't fit on a phone screen. 

Also loading times for the web version are a bit slow and we all know that some people can't wait more than a few seconds for a game to load.

replies.author: TheAlqyngh
replies.body: which game are you talking about? claude did what?

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
You said the AI failed 4-6 times to make your game mobile. 

I was just replying that Claude Code made my game mobile with no problem, I just said I wanted the game to work on mobile devices.

replies.author: TheAlqyngh
replies.body: Oh! Okay I used Rosebud AI not Claude.

replies.author: TheAlqyngh
replies.body: Powered by Gemini Flash, I don't have Rosebud Premium, but I think there is an option to use Fable 5.0 on [Rosebud.ai](http://Rosebud.ai)

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Its need a core loop, what is teh coor loop and progression; that wasn't clear

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Core loop. Look up developing your games core loop.

replies.author: TheAlqyngh
replies.body: I partially  know what it is, isn't it like you reward the player and make them play your game more?

replies.author: TheAlqyngh
replies.body: I really cannot think of anything to make it a core loop progression, please give me some ideas.
